title: Continuation doctrine and next acceptance gates
summary: Continue from the dev10 repository/package candidate while retaining dev9 as Current Library. First obtain a clean presenter-owned HID/hidraw generation with the corrected asynchronous binding waits; then qualify libfido2 and browser WebAuthn; only then move the same semantic device onto a powered hardware SoC and replace development security providers.
invariants: Do not change CTAP2/CTAPHID semantics merely because a Raw Gadget host test fails before HID binding.
Do not accept a USB node that cannot be tied to the current presenter generation.
Do not restore FidoTestHost to the Raw Gadget path.
Do not claim production security while deterministic credential seeds, none attestation or always-present development presence remain.
Do not hand-assemble dependency paths by first filesystem match.
Do not claim whole-device trust merely because FIDO transactions pass.
procedure: 1. On an idle dummy_udc.0, run tests/bringup_live_raw_gadget_fido.sh from dev10 with the locked dependency roots.
2. If it fails, inspect the persisted RAWGADGET trace and current kernel USB diagnostics before modifying code.
3. When HID class 03 and hidraw bind, record that target evidence and update package validation/sphere qualification.
4. If available, qualify libfido2 discovery and basic authenticator information as a separate gate.
5. Qualify browser/WebAuthn registration and assertion as a separate relying-party gate.
6. Port the presenter to a powered SoC/USB device controller. Storage may hold the runtime/image, but the SoC executes it and owns USB presentation.
7. Replace deterministic development entropy/store, development presence and none attestation with qualified hardware-backed providers.
8. Publish an exact expected USB personality and reject undeclared interfaces/personality changes.
9. Integrate package dependency resolution with SSC/Deployment so the same locked dependency closure is reproducible without manual environment assembly.
10. Revisit dynamic Raw Gadget endpoint assignment for UDCs whose endpoint addresses/capabilities cannot satisfy the current fixed profile.

provenance.claim: Validation defines the immediate clean live-host acceptance gate.
Architecture records current Raw Gadget fixed-endpoint portability work and provider/security boundaries.
dev10 is the immediate clean-live qualification candidate and adds asynchronous HID/hidraw wait evidence.
